title: Learning Interaction Dynamics via Motion-Region Guidance for Robotic Video World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Action-conditioned video world models imagine future observations under candidate robot actions, providing a promising visual tool for robot policy evaluation and interaction simulation. However, existing video world models often optimize global reconstruction errors instead of emphasizing interaction-relevant regions. As a result, they may preserve overall scene appearance but overlook local interaction details, leading to physically implausible outcomes such as hallucinated contact effects and inconsistent robot-object interactions. We introduce MoReWorld, a unified motion-region-guided framework that uses a shared motion region, the part of the environment that moves in response to the robot's actions, to focus dynamics learning and video generation on interaction-relevant regions. translated_title: 基于运动区域引导学习交互动态的机器人视频世界模型
translated_abstract: 动作条件视频世界模型能够在候选机器人动作下想象未来的观测结果，为机器人策略评估和交互模拟提供了一种有前景的视觉工具。然而，现有的视频世界模型通常优化全局重建误差，而非强调与交互相关的区域。因此，它们可能保留整体场景外观，却忽略局部交互细节，导致物理上不合理的结果，例如幻觉式接触效果和不一致的机器人-物体交互。我们提出了MoReWorld，一个统一的运动区域引导框架，它利用共享的运动区域（即环境中随机器人动作而移动的部分），将动态学习和视频生成聚焦于与交互相关的区域。同一运动区域引导局部运动预测、区域感知监督以及运动门控的未来特征条件化。在推理时，运动（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MoReWorld通过共享运动区域引导机制，将机器人视频世界模型的动态学习与视频生成聚焦于交互相关区域，解决了幻觉接触和不一致机器人-物体交互等物理不合理问题。
en_tdlr: MoReWorld is a unified motion-region-guided framework that focuses dynamics learning and video generation of robotic video world models on interaction-relevant regions, overcoming physically implausible outcomes such as hallucinated contact effects and inconsistent robot-object interactions.
